deficits.trigger: Need to choose among a growing tool surface without loading everything
deficits.resolution: Provider-neutral registry discovery and deterministic ranking implemented in tools/tool-registry.mjs

deficits.trigger: A candidate tool can be useful but unsafe or over-privileged
deficits.resolution: Fail-closed manifest admission implemented in tools/tool-admission.mjs; sensitive permissions require approval

deficits.trigger: We need a capability not present in the accepted registry
deficits.resolution: Provider-neutral scaffold factory implemented in tools/tool-factory.mjs; generated adapters remain explicitly unimplemented until tested

deficits.trigger: A test or tool failure must create a reproducible capability deficit and next action
deficits.resolution: Failure classification and deficit-to-factory specification implemented in tools/capability-loop.mjs

deficits.trigger: Trusted-source candidates must be executed against real upstream implementations before promotion
deficits.evidence: Current GitHub connector can inspect repository source and CI but this turn does not provide a general arbitrary-process runner against every external MCP server
deficits.nextAction: Run candidate-specific integration tests in a network-enabled sandbox and promote only passing tools

deficits.trigger: SKILL.md files can be structurally audited, but natural-language skills need task fixtures to prove behavioral outcomes
deficits.evidence: skill-audit.mjs now checks operational contract structure but does not execute prose instructions as an agent runtime
deficits.nextAction: Add fixture-driven skill harness that maps each skill to deterministic inputs, expected evidence and failure cases
